description:
You are a wind turbine blade designer creating a small horizontal-axis wind turbine (HAWT) blade with a 5-meter radius. Professional blade designs use different airfoil profiles along the span: thicker symmetric airfoils near the root provide structural strength, while thinner cambered airfoils near the tip maximize aerodynamic efficiency.

Two airfoil coordinate files are available in /home/ga/Documents/airfoils/:
- naca0015.dat (symmetric, 15% thickness — use for the root/inboard region)
- naca4412.dat (cambered, 12% thickness — use for the tip/outboard region)

Your task:
1. Import both airfoils into QBlade so they are available for blade definition.
2. In the HAWT blade design module, create a new blade with at least 6 radial stations spanning from the hub (approximately 0.5m radius) to the tip (5.0m radius).
3. Assign NACA 0015 to the inboard stations and NACA 4412 to the outboard stations.
4. Set the chord distribution to taper from approximately 0.5m at the root to approximately 0.15m at the tip.
5. Save the complete project to /home/ga/Documents/projects/my_hawt_blade.wpa.

You are already logged in as user 'ga'.
